reason: The text describes Yahweh actively delivering and protecting the Hebrew people from Egyptian bondage. Key evidence includes: (1) Yahweh commanding their liberation from Egypt, (2) granting them favor in the eyes of the Egyptians (וַֽיהוָ֞ה נָתַ֨ן אֶת־ חֵ֥ן הָעָ֛ם בְּעֵינֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם), (3) permitting them to take their flocks and possessions, (4) personally bringing them out of Egypt (הוֹצִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל), and (5) establishing protective covenant laws (the Passover) for their benefit. The entire passage portrays Yahweh as a savior and benefactor to the Hebrew people, not as antagonistic toward them.
